title: Forward waypoints
one_line: The next steps in order, each with what we know about it, why it beats the alternatives, and what would make us drop it.

bottom_line.label: The deadline is behind us
bottom_line.text: Zach said on 2026-10-15 that the monday.com take-home was submitted yesterday, 2026-10-14. That is his statement; this session did not verify which build went in. The latest build on disk is submission-rc46.zip (4.2 MB, built 2026-10-14 12:46, tag rc46-2026-10-14) in ~/ret-rfp-intelligence/dist. The 2026-10-13 handoff block in CLAUDE.md still lists the submission as due, so it is stale. An earlier version of this page ranked the deadline first for that reason; the closing fact had never been written down.

bottom_line.label: Two dated clocks
bottom_line.text: Ticket GW-002 (request limits and spend caps) is waived until 2026-10-28, 11 days out as of 2026-10-17. The firewall was read that day, it had no custom rules, and a log-only rule is now live. The Lore falsifier says that by 2027-01-01, 78 days out, some cohort must reach 30 closed outcomes. The system has 1 real closure in 261 receipts as of 2026-10-03. At that rate the deadline will most likely be missed unless outcome capture changes.

bottom_line.label: What 'proven' means here
bottom_line.text: Almost nothing below is proven. Four labels are used: PROVEN means it ran and passed, DERISKED means a cheap test with a failing and a passing case is written down, UNTESTED means neither, and BLOCKED means it waits on a decision. Ranking favors cheap, reversible steps that produce a number.

decisions.question: Take W1 to W4 as the next sitting, after the take-home is submitted?
decisions.recommended: Yes. Commit the work to a branch (done), report the dangling references, save Field view snapshots, plant a known echo. About half a day in total, all read-only.
decisions.why: Each is cheap, reversible and turns an open question into a number. None needs production access.

decisions.question: Will you tag provenance (real or test) on the 78 untagged receipts?
decisions.recommended: Yes, in one pass with the existing candidate-listing script. Only you can set it, and it is never guessed.
decisions.why: Without it no cohort count is trustworthy, so the 2027-01-01 test cannot even be read.

decisions.question: Pull GW-002 forward from its 2026-10-28 waiver?
decisions.recommended: Yes, and keep the log-only rule running a day first. The firewall was read on 2026-10-17 and a log-only rule was published the same day. Next is the blocking step, then a spend cap, before 2026-10-28.
decisions.why: The in-memory limiter is per server instance, and a known-bad case already reproduces the gap.

tables.title: Waypoints in recommended order
tables.intro: Evidence class: PROVEN ran and passed. DERISKED a cheap test is specified. UNTESTED no test yet. BLOCKED waits on a decision. Cost is rough effort to a first result.
columns: Why it is safer or better than the alternatives
rows: Zach said it is submitted. Not verified here, and not checked which build went in. The handoff block that listed it as due is stale.
Nothing to drop. Update the handoff block.
Commit this work to a branch
Worktrees get cleaned up (a repo memory records the trap) and 4 checkpoints are already flagged unclaimed. Losing the renderer, ranking and proposals costs hours. Committing costs minutes.
Never. Needs your go, since commits are on request.
Ran against current main: no dangling references. The earlier figure of 52 was my counting error (a string read as characters); this page said so wrongly until corrected.
Save a dated Field view snapshot per run
probe done 2026-10-17; writer still to build
Without it rank flips and flow cannot be measured at all. Test: zero phantom flips on an unchanged repo.
Snapshots show nothing changing for two weeks.
Plant a known echo in the echo detector
done 2026-10-17 on the offline detector; embedding path and real stones untested
The one test that separates a blind detector from an empty field. Zero real echoes was the 2026-09-27 result. Also unblocks the HUD echo strip.
The planted echo fires: then the detector is sound and the field is empty.
Tag provenance on the 78 untagged receipts
A listing script exists and the write path is built. It is a prerequisite for any cohort count.
You prefer to start a fresh tagged cohort instead.
Read the firewall, publish a log-only rate limit, then promote it to a blocking action
read and log-only rule done 2026-10-17; promote before 2026-10-28

The firewall had no custom rules. A log-only rule (10 per minute per IP on the compass route) is live and blocks nothing. A check of its logs is scheduled for 2026-10-18 at 7 PM. Blocking waits on that, and on a test of how the page handles a 429. Hobby and Pro cannot do an hourly or daily cap.
The log shows no request over 10 per minute for a week, which would make the limit moot.
Browser leak check as a build gate
Scored 0 hits today. Making it a gate stops a silent regression for the price of one script.
Prompt and gate constants move out of the app entirely.
Ex-ante receipts and witness stubs for today's pre-registrations
Timestamps the predictions before counting. The mechanism is cheap, but there is no check yet that anyone reads them.
A receipt costs more attention than the claim is worth.
Empiricism ledger: class, n, falsifier per claim
Directly raises the bar you named. Judgment heavy, so weights stay assumed until anchors are applied to real claims.
The first 20 rows all land in one class.
Trim the anonymous answer plus the sealed package
Bigger change to a production route. The design reads the code but has no prototype, so it ranks below the controls that already have a test.
A prototype breaks the save path.
Private atlas explorer prototype, with two independent axes: the altitude gate (L levels) and the structural invariant (strata and domains)
Waits on you defining the two axes, since they are separate and I had wrongly merged them. The HUD already draws the lattice, so the new part is the per-surface nav.
The HUD gap list is closed another way.
The only item that gives a second vantage on your own intuition. Highest value, highest cost to your time.
73 of 86 open rows have no cost. Running it first would be confident output about nothing.
Capacity per answer is unmeasured, and a paraphrase strips it. Measure capacity first, read-only.
Median active sites per answer is under 32.

human: W0 is done. Pick the next waypoint by cost and dependency.
Prefer the waypoint that makes a number appear. A framework that produces no number stays at the bottom.
A waypoint with a date beats one without. Two are dated: 2026-10-28 and 2027-01-01.
If a waypoint has no 'drop it if', it has no kill condition and should not be on the list.

Never tag provenance. Only the owner sets it.
W0 is closed on Zach's word. The handoff block in CLAUDE.md is stale and should be updated through /handoff, not edited here.
Keep the order stable between runs. A rank flip needs a recorded cause.
Mint no ADR number until a decision is approved.
